name: cycle-planner
title: Cycle Planner
description: Plan cycle scope against capacity using issue estimates.
usage: <CyclePlanner cycleId="Q2" capacity={12} defaultIssues={[{ id: "UI-7", title: "Search", status: "active", priority: "high", points: 3, cycleId: "Q2" }]} />
useCases: Before a sprint, a team adds estimated issues to a cycle and sees how many points still fit.
When capacity changes, a lead removes an issue from the cycle and checks whether the plan is back within budget.
task: Plan cycle scope against capacity using issue estimates.
behavior: cycleId associates issues with the cycle and capacity sets its point budget. Share issues and onIssuesChange to synchronize with the board.
